# tcs-format-doodle

Builds the doodle/whiteboard-format scenes of a lesson storyboard — hand-drawn line-art figures, marker arrows and handwritten notes drawn on in sync with narration (a draw-on sequence spec).

Part of the **[Training Content Studio](../training-content-studio/README.md)** plugin.

## What it's for
Express one approved lesson as a whiteboard draw-on sequence: every visual element is a `whiteboard` item that is
"drawn" when its `^` cue is spoken. Ideal for cause→effect chains, mental models and simple processes.

## When to use it
- Use when the chosen or requested format is "doodle", "whiteboard", "sketch", "draw-my-life" or "hand-drawn explainer".
- **Not for:** flat motion graphics with B-roll (tcs-format-explainer) or coloured character stories (tcs-format-cartoon).

## Install
```bash
# whole plugin (recommended: scripts use the shared schemas/, kit/, assets/)
git clone https://github.com/TamerElsherif/tamer-skills && claude --plugin-dir tamer-skills/training-content-studio
# this skill only (instructions only; its scripts need the plugin root)
npx skills add TamerElsherif/tamer-skills --skill tcs-format-doodle --agent claude-code
```
Prerequisites: Python 3.12 venv with `tools/requirements.txt` (plugin root); keys via env or `TCS_ENV_FILE` (`OPENAI_API_KEY` for narration/transcription, `PEXELS_API_KEY` optional); Node 18+ and ffmpeg for video renders.

## How to use
```
/tcs-format-doodle <request or file>
```
**Inputs**

- Approved lesson from `curriculum.yaml` (objectives, `duration_min`), facts from `sources.yaml`.
- Persona ids (`assets/characters/personas.yaml`, domain `personas.yaml`) — doodle draws them in ink line-art.
- Domain `format_defaults.yaml` (music `whiteboard`), theme preset `whiteboard` from `assets/theme_presets.yaml`.

**Outputs**

- `scenes[]` built mainly from `whiteboard` (the draw-on spec), framed by `title`, `quiz`, `checklist`, `outro`
  (render in ink style when `theme.preset: whiteboard`). Optional `definition` / `steps` for dense recaps.
- `theme.preset: "whiteboard"`, `music.bed: "whiteboard"`, `cast[]` of personas drawn.
- The draw-on sequence spec = `props.items[]` in cue order:
  `{cue, kind: person|icon|note|arrow|circle|underline|box|cross|check, cast?, pose?, expr?, icon?, text?, x, y, w?, h?, to?, color: ink|attention|safe}`.
- Fill-ins: `templates/script_template.md`, `templates/drawon_spec.md`; fragment `templates/example.storyboard.json`.

## Examples
**Example 1: Whiteboard**
Prompt: `do this lesson as a whiteboard doodle`
Result: Draw-on sequence spec: ink personas, arrows, handwriting notes per cue.
